lock.delete.title: Delete the lock file?
lock.refused.hidden: {file} wasn't deleted: this system hides other users' programs, so Glowfly can't tell whether Git is running.
lock.refused.no_list: {file} wasn't deleted: Glowfly couldn't read the list of running programs, so it can't tell whether Git is running.
lock.refused.place: {file} wasn't deleted: it isn't a plain file in this repository's Git folder.
lock.refused.running: {file} wasn't deleted: Git is still running ({programs}). Wait for it to finish, then try again.
lock.refused.sandbox: {file} wasn't deleted: the Flatpak sandbox hides the programs outside it, so Glowfly can't tell whether Git is running.
lock.refused.unreadable: {file} wasn't deleted: Glowfly couldn't read the names of some running programs, so it can't tell whether Git is running.
lock.refused.wsl: {file} wasn't deleted: a WSL session is open, and Glowfly can't see whether Git runs inside it.
